description: This file defines the DoNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a 'do' node that executes an expression without outputting result.

classes.name: Twig\Node\DoNode
classes.description: Represents a 'do' node in the Twig AST for executing an expression within a template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DoNode with an expression and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the DoNode into PHP code that executes the expression.
